explicit_deadline_basis.qualification: Bounds cease to apply if a required pioneer dies or an income activation fails.

formation_structure.clearance: After hostile clearance, Steward RIGHT covers [1,6], retained Lava RIGHT covers [6,6], GALLUS² LEFT covers [6,2], and redeployed Durin LEFT covers [1,2]. No target-selection command is assumed.
formation_structure.final_ground: Cardigan upper outer, Melantha upper central, Midnight lower central and Beagle lower outer.
formation_structure.lower: Beagle replaces Friston-3 before the recorded collapse window. Ansel [5,3] RIGHT covers both lower holds and Lava.
formation_structure.opening: Four column-5 holds. Hibiscus covers both upper holds from 25.1 seconds. Lancet-2 supplies a global heal at 28.5 seconds and temporary lower healing.
formation_structure.patrol: Steward [2,7] UP covers [2,7] and [5,7]; Lava covers lower eastern passes. Ground blocking receives no credit against the flyer.
formation_structure.upper: Hibiscus [2,5] RIGHT covers the upper holds and Steward. After patrol death, Durin [2,3] RIGHT covers both upper column-5 holds.

If the patrol is observed dead, retreat Steward and deploy Durin into the freed slot. Otherwise retain Steward; patrol exit without death invalidates the plan.

After hostile clearance, remove medical and central combat operators, transfer Steward to the vacated upper medical tile and deploy GALLUS² on the vacated lower medical tile. Durin returns facing LEFT only after 70 actual seconds off field.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: At most eight deployed operators; ordered replacements retire their predecessors first.
Do not credit unsupported talents, Cardigan or Spot healing, splash geometry, refunds, summons or target overrides.
Never assign ordinary attacks or ordinary blocking to civilians. Officer proximity can damage civilians and civilian death deducts objective life.
A lost blocker or missed income is a survival or handoff failure that invalidates dependent actions.
Same-frame replacements are a current-model technique, not a claim about exact client timing.
Retain patrol attackers until observed patrol death; a living patrol at exit is a failure.
Do not initiate clearance while hostile spawns remain or any hostile is alive.
Conditional actions require actual deployment, DP, slot, cooldown and skill readiness; defer dependent groups together rather than executing a partial handoff.
WIN requires remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies; 211 seconds is only the last model spawn.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish four holds, heal the upper engagement at 25.1 seconds, apply the global heal during injuries at 28.5 seconds and replace the lower robot before collapse.
Preserve lower interception through the healing gap, establish Ansel, and start Steward's patrol coverage without buying an early sniper.
Boost lower healing for Lava, sustain upper caster healing, complete ground upgrades and kill the patrol before exit.
Transfer the upper caster slot to Durin after patrol death; use upper sustained Arts and Midnight's first Arts window against armor.
Maintain all four holds through outer officers, central runner pairs and final armor; avoid withdrawing a blocker to chase damage.
Continue combat skills and healing until every hostile is dead. Then execute clearance, wait for civilian resolution and evaluate the complete WIN predicate.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Keep V2's early healing and defender funding rather than V9's early sniper expenditure. Replace CONFESS-47 with Castle-3 for supported ordinary attack damage, time Lancet-2's global heal during opening injuries, and use ordered same-frame replacements under the current model. Steward covers both eastern patrol waits, then Durin inherits upper ground damage. Roadblock clearance starts only after hostile combat is resolved.

Steward and Lava surviving patrol fire and delivering 13000 cumulative damage before exit despite competing targets.
Durin and sustained healing clearing upper armor quickly enough to prevent Melantha's later collapse.
Client target priority, client handoff timing and device effects on ordinary WALK navigation.

revised_stage_understanding.CURRENT_MODEL: Ordered actions within a frame precede enemy movement. Ranged enemies select the nearest eligible operator; ordinary ground blocking checks passage through the operator tile. These rules do not establish client timing or priority.
revised_stage_understanding.GameData: Four ground approaches, one flying patrol, two neutral civilians and four occupied roadblocks.
revised_stage_understanding.UNKNOWN: Client handoff timing, target priority, ordinary WALK navigation around devices and sufficient cumulative patrol damage.
revised_stage_understanding.scope: Opening through hostile clearance, roadblock destruction, civilian resolution and WIN. No simulation performed.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.acceptance: Opening blockers and medics survive, the patrol dies before exit, every hostile route clears without leaks, and both civilians resolve before WIN.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.limitation: Static economy and range checks support the assignments; survival and lethal throughput remain unverified.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Restore early medical support and lower defender replacement, improve temporary upper interception, eliminate the model's movement gap during replacements, concentrate patrol coverage before transferring the upper caster slot to sustained armor damage, and reuse casters for clearance after combat.
